name: Zombville General
description: Zombville General Hospital, the last stop in the city: the lobby with its fountain, surgery in the west wing, patient care and the ICU in the east, the ER and the ambulance bay, radiology, the lab, the pharmacy, the cafeteria, the gift shop, the chapel and the morgue, a hallway all the way round; many rooms sealed off. Backup power: lights broken and hanging, sparks, the fire alarms pulsing red. The military is evacuating from the roof.
